Messages.Author: Johannes Walch
Messages.Body:
When an Imbued enters play I can put a Conviction on him from
library/hand/ash-heap.

What if I search my library and fail to find a Conviction, can I still
take from hand/ash-heap?

Can I deliberately fail to find a Convicition in my library even if
there is one for the sake of shuffling my library (e.g bringing up cards
from Heart of Cheating)?

Messages.Author: Powerlord
Messages.Body:


My answer is yes.

In http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/index.php?line=Checklist_NightsOfReckoning
point 2 "Conviction" it states:
"(...) When an imbued enters play with no conviction, he may gain 1
conviction from your library, hand or ash heap. (...)"

So you can either go throught your asheap, hand OR library. If you
choose your library and you know that you don't have any left, you are
playing in a less sports manner, but I don't think it is an illegal
play.

But let's wait for the expert's (LSJ) answer. :)

Ricardo Marta
Prince of Lisboa
Portugal
